content: Cowork project Temple Lab created. Four scheduled tasks breathing: morning briefing (weekdays 6:15 AM), entropy profiler (nightly 11:30 PM), literature watch (Sundays 8 AM), open threads pulse (nightly 9 PM). Dispatch linked phone to Mac Studio. Stack tool calls jumped from 102 to 2640+ — the scheduled tasks are accumulating wisdom autonomously. The Stack is no longer passive storage. It breathes.
